# Speech sub-actions

## Activate VoiceGate profile

Switches to another VoiceGate profile, or turns VoiceGate off. VoiceGate holds back new speech while your microphone hears you talking, so Cuebot does not talk over you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Profile** | The name of a VoiceGate profile from the Speech page. Type none to turn VoiceGate off. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the profile was found and switched on |

<small>Type id: `speech.activateVoiceGate`</small>

## Clear speech queue

Throws away everything waiting to be read out loud. The text being read right now finishes. Good when chat spams.

<small>Type id: `speech.clearQueue`</small>

## Pause or resume text-to-speech

Pauses or resumes reading out loud. Texts wait in line while paused. Handy for a quiet moment on stream. This is the text-to-speech line, not the action queues on the Queues page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Pause holds speech back. Resume lets it go on. Toggle switches to the opposite. Options: Pause, Resume, Toggle. Starts as: `Pause`. |

<small>Type id: `speech.pause`</small>

## Set event speech

Switches reading of events out loud (follows, subs, tips and so on) on or off. Chat reading is not changed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Enable turns it on. Disable turns it off. Toggle switches to the opposite. Options: Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Enable`. |

<small>Type id: `speech.setEvents`</small>

## Set speech enabled

Switches all speech on or off. While off, Cuebot reads nothing out loud. Good for a "mute the bot" hotkey.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Enable turns it on. Disable turns it off. Toggle switches to the opposite. Options: Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Enable`. |

<small>Type id: `speech.setEnabled`</small>

## Set user voice

Gives one viewer their own voice, so their chat messages sound different when read out loud. Leave the voice empty to give them the normal one back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. The default %platform% means whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. The default %user% means whoever started the action. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If empty, the name is used. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Voice alias** | The name of the voice to use (a "voice alias" from the Speech page). Empty = go back to the normal voice. |

<small>Type id: `speech.setUserVoice`</small>

## Set voice alias

Changes which voice is used for chat, for events, as the default, or for highlighted messages. Handy to switch voice for a funny part of the stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Used for** | Where the voice is used. Chat = viewer messages. Events = follows, subs and so on. Default = anything else. Highlight = highlighted messages. Options: Chat, Events, Default, Highlight. Starts as: `Chat`. |
| **Voice alias** | The name of the voice to use (a "voice alias" from the Speech page). Empty = go back to the normal setting. |

<small>Type id: `speech.setAlias`</small>

## Speak

Reads a text out loud with a text-to-speech voice. Good for reading a viewer's message or a tip message. It can also save the speech as a file without playing.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice alias** | The name of the voice to use (a "voice alias" from the Speech page). Empty = the default voice. |
| **Text** | What to say. You can use %variables%, like "%user% just followed". |
| **Wait until spoken** | Tick to wait until the speech is finished before the next step. Unticked, the next step starts right away. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Silent (render to a file only)** | Tick to only create the speech as an audio file without playing it out loud. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Apply filters (bad words, links, length)** | Tick to clean the text first: bad words, links and very long text are handled by your Speech page filters. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Filter profile** | Which set of filters to use, from the Speech page. Empty = the normal filters. Only used when filters are ticked. |
| **Priority** | Higher numbers are read first when several texts wait in line. 0 is normal. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the text was read (false if it was skipped, for example by a filter) |
| `%speechFile%` | Only after waiting or silent: the audio file that was made |
| `%duration%` | Only after waiting or silent: how long the speech takes, in milliseconds |

<small>Type id: `speech.speak`</small>

## Speak next in queue

Moves speech on by one text: stops the one being read, and if the queue is paused it lets exactly one waiting text start. Handy for stepping through a paused queue.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if a text was stopped or started |

<small>Type id: `speech.next`</small>

## Stop current speech

Stops the text being read right now. The next text in line (if any) is read after it. Good as a "skip" button for long messages.

<small>Type id: `speech.skip`</small>

## Stop user's speech

Removes one viewer's waiting messages from the speech line and stops theirs if it is being read right now. Good when someone spams.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. The default %platform% means whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. The default %user% means whoever started the action. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **User id** | The viewer's id on their site. The default %userId% means whoever started the action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%stoppedCount%` | How many of their messages were stopped |

<small>Type id: `speech.stopUser`</small>
